name: Le Méridien Tampa, The Courthouse
positioning: Boutique hotel in Tampa's century-old Historic Federal Courthouse, in the heart of downtown Tampa
best_for: Travelers who want to stay inside a historic building with original architectural details
City stays in downtown Tampa with an art museum visit included

facts.text: The hotel occupies Tampa's century-old Historic Federal Courthouse, transformed into a hotel.
The building has marble hallways and original oak doors from when it was erected in 1905.
Before it was a courthouse, the building originated as a post office and customs house.
An old judge's desk has been repurposed as the Concierge Desk.
The ceilings on the fourth floor still display intricate hand-painted designs from a century ago.
The gold eagle in the courtroom has remained untouched.
Historic courtrooms have been repurposed as meeting rooms and event venues.
The hotel is located in the heart of downtown Tampa.
Beds have pillowtop mattresses, down comforters and 250-thread sheets.
Facilities include an outdoor pool and a 24-hour fitness center with Peloton bikes.
Sal Rosa serves bold Latin-American flavors and handcrafted cocktails inside the historic Courthouse.
Café + Scoops serves freshly brewed coffee, flaky pastries, house-made ice cream and seasonal gelato.

highlights.text: The building's former holding cells are now the guest rooms overlooking the pool.
Rooms and suites are former courtroom offices with custom details such as deep wood-tones and original high ceilings.
The hotel partners with the nearby Tampa Museum of Art, where guests receive complimentary entry.
Rooms offer views of the downtown Tampa skyline from floor-to-ceiling windows.

considerations.text: The minimum age to check in is 21.
Rollaway beds are not permitted in any of the rooms.
